name: archive_account
description: Archives an envelope: it disappears from get_budget_context and new-expense choices and takes no new limits; its expenses stay. Reversible with restore_account. Needs the revision from get_account.

name: clear_limit
description: Removes an envelope's limit for one month, back to no limit. Needs the revision from list_limits. Clearing a limit that is already gone succeeds.

name: create_account
description: Creates an envelope in the caller's household budget. Not idempotent: after a lost response, check get_budget_context before calling again. Household envelopes are for owners and adults; personal ones belong to the caller or a member the caller manages.

ownerPersonId.description: Personal only: owner person id, for a member the caller manages; the caller when omitted. Omit for Household.

name: create_expense
description: Records an expense in an envelope the caller can use. Idempotent per operationKey: repeat the same call with the same key after a lost response and you get the original expense (created=false), never a duplicate. Use a new key for a new expense. Validation errors name the field, e.g. "Amount: ...". Read get_budget_context first for envelope ids, category codes, funding sources and adults.

operationKey.description: Idempotency key: a fresh GUID per logical expense, reused only when retrying that same call.

amount.description: Positive decimal string with at most two decimals, e.g. "123.45".

paidByPersonId.description: Payer person id; only for an individually funded shared expense.

participantIds.description: Adult person ids sharing the cost equally; required for an individually funded shared expense, omit otherwise.

description.description: Optional short note, at most 80 characters.

name: get_account
description: Returns one envelope the caller can see, archived or not, with the revision that rename_account, archive_account and restore_account need. get_budget_context lists only active envelopes.

name: get_budget_context
description: Returns the household budget (null until it is set up in the app), the active envelopes the caller can see, the category and funding source codes, and the owners and adults who can pay for or share a household expense. Call it first: other budget tools take ids and codes from it.

name: get_budget_summary
description: Returns one month's spending by envelope and by category, with exact totals as decimal strings. "Shared" covers household envelopes (owners and adults only); "Personal" covers one person's envelopes. Voided expenses never count.

ownerPersonId.description: Personal scope only: whose envelopes, the ownerPersonId of a personal envelope from get_budget_context; the caller when omitted.

name: get_expense
description: Returns one expense the caller can see, with its stored shares and its full correction history, oldest first.

name: get_settlement
description: Returns who owes whom across all recorded shared expenses and repayments: each adult's net balance and the suggested payments that would settle everyone. Owners and adults only. Amounts are decimal strings.

name: list_limits
description: Lists the monthly limits set for one month on envelopes the caller can see, each with the revision that set_limit (when changing) and clear_limit need. Envelopes without a limit are absent; "0.00" is a real limit.

name: list_repayments
description: Pages recorded repayments, newest payment date first, voided ones included and marked. Each carries the revision that void_repayment needs. Owners and adults only.

name: record_repayment
description: Records that one adult actually paid another; no money moves through the app. Owners and adults only, and either party may be named. Idempotent per operationKey: repeat the same call with the same key after a lost response and you get the original repayment (created=false), never a duplicate. A payment larger than the suggestion is recorded as stated. Person ids come from get_settlement or get_budget_context.

operationKey.description: Idempotency key: a fresh GUID per logical repayment, reused only when retrying that same call.

toPersonId.description: Person id of who received; must differ from the payer.

amount.description: Positive decimal string with at most two decimals, e.g. "40.00".

paidOn.description: Date the payment was made, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: rename_account
description: Renames an envelope the caller may manage. Needs the revision from get_account; a revision conflict means it changed since: call get_account and decide again.

name: restore_account
description: Restores an archived envelope so it can take new expenses again. Needs the revision from get_account.

accountId.description: Envelope id from get_account (archived envelopes are not in get_budget_context).

name: search_expenses
description: Pages the expenses the caller can see, newest purchase first, with exact totals over the whole filter (not just the page). Every filter is optional. Amounts are decimal strings.

accountId.description: Only this envelope, an account id from get_budget_context.

category.description: Only this category code from get_budget_context.

amount.description: Only this exact amount, decimal string such as "123.45".

search.description: Case-insensitive text matched against the description.

includeVoided.description: Also return voided expenses; they never count towards totals.

name: set_limit
description: Sets or changes an envelope's spending limit for one month; "0.00" is allowed and differs from no limit. Setting for the first time sends no revision; changing an existing limit needs its revision from list_limits. Not allowed on archived envelopes.

amount.description: Decimal string with at most two decimals, e.g. "1500.00".

expectedRevision.description: The existing limit's revision from list_limits; omit when setting for the first time.

name: update_expense
description: Corrects an expense in place; envelope and recorder cannot change. Send every field (current values to keep them), the revision from get_expense and a reason. A revision conflict means it changed since: call get_expense and decide again. Idempotent per operationKey. Voided expenses cannot be edited.

operationKey.description: Idempotency key: a fresh GUID per correction, reused only when retrying that same call.

expectedRevision.description: The expense's current revision from get_expense.

amount.description: Positive decimal string with at most two decimals.

paidByPersonId.description: Payer person id; only for an individually funded shared expense.

participantIds.description: Adult person ids sharing the cost equally.

description.description: Short note, at most 80 characters; omitted or blank clears it.

name: void_expense
description: Voids an expense: it stops counting towards totals and can no longer be edited; its history stays and this cannot be undone. Needs the revision from get_expense and a reason. Repeating a completed void adds no revision.

operationKey.description: Idempotency key: a fresh GUID per void, reused only when retrying that same call.

expectedRevision.description: The expense's current revision from get_expense.

name: void_repayment
description: Voids a recorded repayment so the debt it reduced is restored; it cannot be undone (record a new repayment instead). Needs the revision from list_repayments and a reason. Repeating a completed void adds nothing. Owners and adults only.
